The '''Emperor's Will''' was a campaign by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to finish off rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] and [[Zaarin coup forces|his splinter government]] once and for all, after an attempt by Zaarin to capture [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] aboard his [[C-3 passenger liner]], the ''[[Excalibur]]'', had resulted in failure and retreat. One of Zaarin's commanders, [[Namuura Din]], attempted to defect to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and warn them that their planned [[Battle of Endor/Legends|assault]] at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] was a trap, and gave them a [[Missile Boat]] prototype called ''[[Sealion]]''. But the defection was thwarted by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]], and the prototype was recovered. Zaarin then proceeded to [[To-phalion Base]] to steal the [[Vorknkx Project]] testbed, which was guarded by loyalist [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. Zaarin was ultimately killed there, largely due to the efforts of [[TIE pilot]] ace [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]]. After the campaign, Stele was awarded the [[Medal of Victory]] medal for saving the Emperor's life and ending the Zaarin insurrection.

==Aftermath==
Stele's participation in the pursuit earned him the [[Medal of Victory]], but prevented him from participating in the Battle of Endor. Zaarin's death was the first of Palpatine's circle of Grand Admirals. The insurrection also prevented the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]], Zaarin's starfighter project, from seeing mass use in the Imperial Navy, at best being restricted to pilots who had survived numerous tours of duty.
